files.doc: 🔧️ The transaction steps of the plan apply: staging, installing, retargeting, editing, regenerating and the verified commit of one attempt.

items.name: stageTransactionOperations
items.doc: Stages the moves, relocations and evidence removals of the attempt into the staging root.

items.name: stageEmbeddedRootsAndInstallMoves
items.doc: Stages the embedded ticket roots and installs the staged moves.

items.name: installRelocationsAndRetargetSymlinks
items.doc: Installs the embedded ticket root relocations and retargets the symlink targets.

items.name: applyReferenceEditGroups
items.doc: Groups the reference edits by path and applies every group atomically.

items.name: regenerateGeneratorOutputs
items.doc: Runs every regeneration command and verifies its outputs against the plan.

items.name: verifyAndCommitTransaction
items.doc: Verifies the post-state, commits the journal, cleans up the transaction and releases the lease.
